title: Release Wiki Config (release-wiki/v1)
description: XACA-1342 / spec docs/release-workflow/RELEASE-LIFECYCLE.md § 11.5. credential.secretRef is never a literal value (§ 2.2, § 11.4-11.5).

provider.description: § 10.2: confluence first; GitHub wiki or repo docs later.

credential.description: Never a literal token -- always a secretRef (§ 2.2, § 11.5).

secretRef.description: vault:<engine_slug>/<account_slug> or env:<VAR_NAME> only. A literal value is a validation error.

baseUrl.description: Wiki tenant base URL, e.g. https://<tenant>.example.net/wiki. This is a public tenant address, not a secret.

docTypes.description: § 12: cr, testing-log, cr-record. Each maps to a space + parent location.

platformName.description: Display name used by template rendering ({{platform.name}}).
